run.objective: Declare the implementation intent for executable loop-quality gates before writing source gate logic.

implementationIntent.title: Implement Hermes Agentic Loop Quality Gate
implementationIntent.summary: Prepare a bounded implementation that evaluates generated drift, timestamp churn, no-op patch claims, human-boundary preservation, and declared-target-only changes.

plannedChecks.purpose: Detect whether validation commands leave generated artifacts dirty without being declared outputs.
plannedChecks.proposedCheck: Capture git status before and after validation, then classify generated artifact drift.

plannedChecks.purpose: Distinguish timestamp-only rewrites from semantic artifact changes.
plannedChecks.proposedCheck: Inspect changed JSON/Markdown artifacts for generatedAt-only or timestamp-only diffs.

plannedChecks.purpose: Prevent apply steps from claiming meaningful source changes when only metadata changed or no diff exists.
plannedChecks.proposedCheck: Require patch reports to expose applied, changed, diffOutput, and semanticChange fields.

plannedChecks.purpose: Preserve the line between workflow preparation and operator GitHub actions.
plannedChecks.proposedCheck: Assert no branch push, PR open, merge, or destructive git operation occurs inside workflow scripts.

plannedChecks.purpose: Ensure source edits stay inside the active contract or approval artifact target list.
plannedChecks.proposedCheck: Compare changed paths against the contract's allowedTargets list.

implementationRules: Read the v8.3 quality gate plan as the source of truth.
Produce one machine-readable quality gate implementation artifact.
Classify drift separately from semantic changes.
Treat timestamp-only churn as noise unless explicitly declared.
Require no-op patch claims to expose applied, changed, diffOutput, and semanticChange.
Preserve the human/operator boundary for branch, push, PR, and merge actions.
Reject changes outside the declared target set.
implementationIntent.expectedNextStep: Generate v8.5 quality gate implementation artifact and gate; do not apply broad source changes yet.

notes: This declares the implementation intent for run v3 loop-quality gates.
